title: Inverted condition
detail: The condition checks if the name starts and ends with '__', which is incorrect. It should check if the name starts with '__' and does not end with '__'. The same applies to line 998.

title: Incorrect assertion
detail: This assertion checks that the `_undefined_obj` of the copied object is the same as the original, which is incorrect. It should check that they are the same. The same applies to lines 119, 121, 123, 125.

title: Potential logic error
detail: This condition will always be false if `cmd_params` is not empty, as `cmd_params` is checked before `less_env`.
